meta.name: lcx-doctor
meta.description: Diagnose LazyCodex and Codex CLI installation health against the latest sources. Use whenever the user asks for a doctor or health check, says LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, or Codex behaves oddly after an install, update, or config change, suspects a stale, drifted, or broken setup, or wants the local install audited and compared with the latest LazyCodex and Codex code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查 Codex 与 LazyCodex 安装,揪出过时或损坏的配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你用 LazyCodex 或 Codex,想确认本地安装健康、与最新版一致。
copy.tagline_en: Check Codex and LazyCodex installs for drift, staleness, or breakage.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use LazyCodex or Codex and worry your local install may be unhealthy or outdated.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会检查你本地的 LazyCodex 与 Codex CLI 安装,和最新源码逐项比对,输出 PASS/WARN/FAIL 体检报告,每条结论都附上对应的命令输出或文件依据。它只做诊断,不改动你的安装、配置或仓库。
howto.when: 当你要求做 doctor 或健康检查、提到 LazyCodex、lazycodex-ai、omo-codex 等关键词,或安装、更新、改配置后 Codex 表现异常时触发。

say.text: 帮我给本地的 LazyCodex 和 Codex 做一次体检
查一下我的 Codex 版本能不能跑 gpt-6-astra
say.note: 看 Astra 就绪项是否 WARN

say.text: 我装完后 Codex 行为有点怪,帮我查哪里出了问题
say.note: 给出按优先级的修复建议

howto.what_en: After install, Claude audits your local LazyCodex and Codex CLI setup against the latest sources and returns a PASS/WARN/FAIL report, each verdict citing the command output or file behind it. It only diagnoses, never changing your install.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for a doctor or health check, mention LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai or omo-codex, or when Codex misbehaves after an install, update or config change.

say_en.text: Run a health check on my local LazyCodex and Codex install
Check whether my Codex version can run gpt-6-astra
say_en.note: Shows Astra readiness as PASS or WARN

say_en.text: Codex behaves oddly after my install - find out why
